result.email_draft:
Subject: Fraud Review Required: Invoice AC7710 – Acme Office Supplies Ltd (V001)

Dear Finance Manager,

Payment for invoice AC7710 from Acme Office Supplies Ltd (V001), totaling USD 555.00, has been blocked due to a possible fraud concern.

The invoice number AC7710 appears similar to AC-7710, which has already been processed for this supplier. The two invoice numbers differ only in punctuation, spacing, leading zeros, look-alike characters, or a trailing letter.

Please verify the invoice directly with the supplier by phone, using the contact details on file. Do not use any contact information printed on the invoice.

Kind regards,
